scope: Read-only architecture prereview. M40 payload was not opened and M453b was not executed.
objective: Define a resource-fair executable exact-derived-PWP architecture for the frozen H67 ep35 q32-parent plus three-child catalog without transferring any PAFT/M267 cycle or checkpoint result.

transferable: PWP(mask)=sum of the sixteen checkpoint-bound signed INT8 weight vectors selected by mask
distinct current/next banks, bank-valid fences and role-switch discipline
a conservative separate child write must be the primary model until RTL proves final-update/write bypass
not_transferable: M267 or M275r2 PAFT checkpoint numeric ranges, cycle totals, transition slack, storage admission or performance ratios
q16 all-center generation counts as q128 used-center generation counts
M451 standalone opportunity as an integrated M461 result

frozen_geometry_known_without_m40.pwp_physical_byte_definition: M453b pwp_stride_bytes=640 per four-output-block tile. One center across two tiles/eight blocks is 2*640=1280 physical bytes, equal to 8*160 padded bytes. Therefore q32 parent cache is 32*640=20,480 bytes per tile and 40,960 bytes across both tiles.

m453a_train_catalog_structural_bound_not.independent_calculation_method: Read only the double-sealed M453a train catalog. Decode every parent/child hex mask; popcount(parent XOR child) over all 32*3 edges per partition. Independently run deterministic zero-rooted Prim on {zero plus 32 parents} with tie tuple (distance, child_index, parent_index). Report each distribution across all 4*432 partitions. No M40 path, M453b result, heldout count or cycle ledger is opened.

all_128_centers_eight_output_block_weigh.formula: 8*(q32 parent zero-rooted Prim MST flips + all 96 parent-child edge flips)
all_128_centers_eight_output_block_weigh.excludes: parent reads, PWP writes, clears, weight/config transfer, matcher, descriptor capture, port conflicts and cold/transition stalls

m453a_train_catalog_structural_bound_not.interpretation: This is a train-catalog structural upper/reference point for all-center generation. It is not an M40 used-center distribution, phase service result, cycle speedup or performance claim.

A_full_q128_direct_address_pwp_cache.reason: It preserves M453b's stored-PWP execution but turns the q128 catalog into a large static direct-address SRAM. It neither closes resource normalization nor supports the claimed payload-elision story. Do not build this point.

B_q32_parent_cache_plus_one_child_scratc.descriptor_layout_64bit: row/destination_id12, original/residual_source16, global_center_id7, distance5, use_pwp1, predecessor12, reserved11
B_q32_parent_cache_plus_one_child_scratc.parent_rows: read the q32 direct-address parent PWP cache
B_q32_parent_cache_plus_one_child_scratc.child_rows: read one 640-byte four-output-block scratch per tile after exact derivation from the selected parent
B_q32_parent_cache_plus_one_child_scratc.pwp_dma_boundary: Child PWP DMA is eliminated. Parent q32 PWP DMA remains unless a separate exact parent materializer is admitted; actual traffic reduction versus M453b must wait for its sealed ledger.
destination_interface_gate: Every list descriptor must keep row/destination ID and global center ID. Residual plus/minus masks are derived from original16 and center16; they are not free metadata.

Parent cache IDs 0..31 fit the M433 five-bit center field. A child scratch must use a local scratch-slot ID while the global child ID remains in the assignment controller; this requires a new protocol shim and is not bit-identical M433 reuse.

The M433 adapter only forwards a destination tag and update_delta. It does not prove the downstream old_psum SRAM accepts center-major random row addresses, one read-modify-write per completed descriptor, or arbitrary destination order.
If an indexed accumulator cannot sustain the frozen issue rate without a new wide port or a large reorder buffer, B is hard NO-GO.
B_q32_parent_cache_plus_one_child_scratc.weight_port_gate: Child derivation and correction replay both require the current 96-byte weight bank. With one port they are serialized. Overlapping next-child derivation with current-child replay is forbidden unless a second read port is explicitly purchased and resource-normalized.
B_q32_parent_cache_plus_one_child_scratc.why_not_admitted_now: Capacity fits a 32KiB per-tile working slot, but no executable assignment-list controller, destination-tagged indexed-accumulator port schedule, or group-order cycle ledger exists.

C_q32_parent_cache_plus_small_child_cach.benefit: It preserves destination order and may avoid B's random-psum/reorder cost.
C_q32_parent_cache_plus_small_child_cach.required_model: Freeze cache slots, replacement rule, miss build recurrence and write/read ports before opening the ordered trace; derive every child miss from its parent and charge both output tiles.
C_q32_parent_cache_plus_small_child_cach.forbidden_shortcut: A used-center set, used_center_runs over sorted IDs, counts, or per-center population cannot predict a row-order child-cache miss stream.

hard_A_B_C_comparison.hard_conclusion: A is closed. The compact original-order used-center bank is the first M461 model because it preserves destination order; its capacity remains unknown until sealed Nmax. B is only a fixed-capacity backup worth an executable pre-RTL interface screen and remains NO-GO for RTL/performance admission until the random-psum/destination-tag contract passes. C remains unknown until an ordered selected-ID ledger exists.

compact_original_order_used_center_bank_.name: double-buffered assignment plus compact used-center derived-PWP bank plus original-order replay
sequence: While phase i replays from the current banks, the hierarchical matcher captures phase i+1 into the inactive 48-bit assignment bank and sets a 128-bit used-PWP-center bitmap.
Load the next phase's 12,288 weight bytes and 288 configuration bytes; no PWP payload is fetched from DRAM.

After assignment seal, visit only centers with pwp_rows greater than zero, grouped by their fixed parent. Clear to zero at each active parent group, construct the parent, then visit the selected children in a fixed minimum-transition permutation with lexicographic ties.

For each of eight output blocks, remove source bits before adding source bits, compare every derived vector against direct INT8 summation, and conservatively use a separate 160-byte compact-bank write cycle.
Write center-to-compact-slot remap entries and assert assignment, weight, configuration and PWP valid only after the final write; role switch requires generator idle.
Replay the current 48-bit descriptors in their original order. A center ID is translated through the remap table only for use-PWP rows; fallback rows remain bit-sparse.
compact_original_order_used_center_bank_.exact_materialization_cycle_formula: For used parent group g, start at zero and let path_g begin at its parent and visit only its used child centers in the fixed minimum-transition order. F=sum_g(popcount(parent_g)+sum Hamming(path transitions)); U=used PWP centers; G=used parent groups. Conservative C_materialize=8*(F+U+G), where U charges separate PWP writes and G charges explicit block clears. No final-update/write overlap is admitted.
compact_original_order_used_center_bank_.preparation_recurrence_to_measure: C_prepare=max(C_match_and_assignment_seal, C_weight_config_DMA)+C_materialize. Cold phase pays C_prepare. In-sample phase i+1 preparation may overlap only the frozen executable service window of phase i; any overrun is exposed before role switch.
why_this_remains_a_required_comparison: It eliminates static q128 PWP DMA and direct-address q128 slot addressing without changing arithmetic or checkpoint.
It retains original descriptor order and therefore does not silently assume random destination-accumulator writes or order-independent finite arithmetic.
Current PWP read, current correction-weight read, next PWP write and next materializer-weight read are placed on distinct current/next bank roles.

logical_storage_lower_bound_primary.two_compact_pwp_banks_physical_bytes: 2560*Nmax, where Nmax is the maximum M453b runtime used-PWP center count in any phase
excluded: output accumulator SRAM and its ports
SRAM macro rounding, banking, ECC, clock tree and interconnect
DMA queues and off-chip interface storage

port_contract_primary.current_pwp_bank: one 160-byte synchronous read per PWP output-block issue
port_contract_primary.next_pwp_bank: one 160-byte synchronous write-only event per materialized center/output block during preparation
port_contract_primary.current_weight_bank: one 96-byte synchronous read per correction-source issue
port_contract_primary.next_weight_bank: one time-multiplexed 32-byte DMA fill or 96-byte generator read; fill and generator read never share a cycle
port_contract_primary.assignment_banks: inactive bank one 48-bit write per accepted active row while current bank supplies one in-order 48-bit replay request per cycle
port_contract_primary.generator: one 96-lane signed13 add/sub datapath; materialization throughput and fold-mode II=1 are not admitted until VCS/DC/PT
port_contract_primary.simultaneous_required_events: current PWP read plus current correction-weight read may coexist with next PWP write plus next generator-weight read only because current and next roles are distinct physical banks

true_group_replay_alternative.feasible_control_structure: Each accepted descriptor stores a 12-bit predecessor pointer. One tail pointer exists for each of 128 PWP-center lists plus one fallback list. This permits deterministic reverse-order group traversal with one descriptor write and one descriptor read per cycle.
hard_problems: Center-major replay changes destination update order; exactness requires a bounded accumulator width proof plus an executable indexed accumulator SRAM hazard/port schedule.
Materializing the next center while replaying the current center competes for the same 96-byte current-weight bank used by correction issues unless a second read port is purchased.
Without concurrent materialization, derived-PWP build cycles become exposed between center groups and can erase the issue reduction.
Reordering to move fold-eligible rows after prep completion changes the idle-window recurrence and cannot inherit M453b row-order cycles.
true_group_replay_alternative.reopen_condition: Only if the compact original-order Nmax bank fails SRAM Pareto and a fixed-order indexed-accumulator model with no added weight port passes a matched-resource screen.

integrated_generator_reuse_hypothesis.motivation: M455 found substantial standalone M451 area growth. Reusing the already-paid next-bank 96-lane generator after next preparation completes may amortize the pre-adder, but reuse is neither free nor continuously available.
mode_fence: GEN_NEXT is exclusive while next weight/config/assignment/PWP preparation is incomplete.
FOLD_CURRENT is legal only after all next-bank valid bits are asserted and the generator has no pending child write.

A fused issue requires one current compact-PWP 160-byte read, one current correction-weight 96-byte read, matching tag/tile/output block, one signed plus/minus control and downstream old_psum accumulation.
Role switch is illegal until the final fold output drains; config reload cannot overlap any request.
integrated_generator_reuse_hypothesis.timeline_model: Run a cycle-accurate two-resource recurrence for every phase. Before prep_done, every PWP and correction issue remains separate. After prep_done, only the first correction of an actually scheduled positive-residual PWP row/output-block may co-issue with its PWP. Recompute phase end after each fusion because shortening current service can reduce the next-prep hiding window. Charge exposed next-prep overrun and cold starts.
port_and_mux_costs_not_free: current-PWP low8/high4 unpack path into the generator
current-weight-bank cross-role mux into the generator
signed materialize/fold mode mux and signed13 result path
tag/tile/output-block metadata buffering and old_psum-compatible downstream arbitration
wires for simultaneous 160-byte PWP and 96-byte weight delivery
required_checks: integrated DC area and unchanged-Fmax comparison against materializer plus M433, not against M451 alone
Formality/PT and mapped switching/PTPX after RTL admission
no transfer of the standalone M451 opportunity ratio

required_from_existing_outputs: per-phase used PWP center set filtered by pwp_rows greater than zero
per-phase used parent/child counts and parent-child Hamming distances
maximum and distribution of used PWP centers, current-slot overflows and actual used PWP DRAM bytes
per-phase separate issue counts, positive-residual PWP rows, matcher cycles and phase service components
missing_for_integrated_reuse_if_only_agg: a frozen ordered descriptor/issue schedule or an explicitly predeclared deterministic replay order
the first cycle at which every positive-residual row/output-block reaches the PWP issue and its first correction
current-phase output-accumulator address order and hazard evidence
m453b_ledger_dependencies.required_action: Do not estimate integrated fold availability by multiplying aggregate positive-residual rows. Either seal an ordered issue ledger before M461 or deterministically reconstruct it from the same sealed M40 source under a new exact-SHA contract without tuning.

gates_for_m461: M453b must pass its predeclared separate-path gate and its independent hammer must have P0=0.
M461 must bind the final M453b result, per-phase CSV, center ledger, inner manifest and outer seal; this prereview binds only the prefreeze draft and does not authorize execution.
Reconstruct every selected used-center/output-block PWP bit-exactly against direct signed INT8 summation and prove stored signed12 range; use a signed13 generator state for the optional fold mode.
Replay all 17,280 phases with cold starts, sample drains, bank valid fences, current/next port conflicts, compact-slot addresses and role switches explicit.
Report stored-q128, compact-original-order and true-group-replay storage/port points separately; no unmeasured macro capacity may be called area.
Only the compact original-order path advances first. True group replay and integrated fold are separate conditional DSE axes.
Independent hammer is mandatory before any RTL; Synopsys VCS precedes DC/Formality/PTPX.

risk_register.risk: M453b's center ledger is aggregate by center and does not by itself bind the ordered issue timing required for prep-gated generator reuse.
risk_register.closure: Seal ordered issue timing or reconstruct it deterministically in M461; otherwise integrated reuse remains zero-credit.

risk_register.risk: A compact PWP bank sized from an average used-center count can overflow a legal phase.
risk_register.closure: Size to sealed Nmax or define an exact spill path and charge it.

risk_register.risk: 48-bit logical assignment SRAM and 160-byte PWP/96-byte weight ports may round to impractical macros.
risk_register.closure: Run explicit 48/64-bit descriptor and bank-sliced PWP/weight macro sensitivities; keep logical storage separate from macro area.

risk_register.risk: Integrated generator fold may fail II=1 or timing after adding wide muxes and signed13 delivery.
risk_register.closure: Treat fold as a conditional axis and require integrated VCS/DC/PT, not standalone M451 transfer.

risk_register.risk: True group replay can introduce random accumulator writes, read-after-write hazards and an unpriced accumulator macro.
risk_register.closure: Keep original-order replay primary; group replay is NO-GO until an executable accumulator schedule passes.

risk_register.risk: Faster current replay from fold can paradoxically expose next preparation by shrinking the overlap window.
risk_register.closure: Use a coupled per-cycle recurrence and charge every overrun before reporting any cycle reduction.

decision.recommended_first_point: compact original-order used-center bank after sealed Nmax; it is the only first model allowed to advance because it preserves destination order
decision.backup_fixed_capacity_screen: B q32-parent cache plus single-child scratch, interface/event screen only

red_lines: Do not read M40 or execute M453b from this prereview.
Do not transfer M267/M275r2 PAFT numeric claims to H67 ep35.
Do not subtract all positive-residual rows as fused; fold availability begins only after exact next-prep completion.
Do not call 88,352 bytes eliminated unless both compact-bank capacity and all replacement assignment/materializer storage are shown.
Do not claim group replay is free or exact without accumulator order/width/port proof.
